description: RENDERS an AI Video Story episode into its final delivered file (stage 3 of 3), after the scene videos are done. It is composed SERVER-side from the stored episode (scenes, captions, music, title card); you pass the episode id, and `watermark` only for the user's own logo. WHEN: `get_video` shows `succeeded` or `story.stage: "ready_to_render"` (an episode edited in the web editor renders with those edits; a later render replaces the file). AFTER: the answer carries `render_id` and `story.stage: "rendering"`; how to wait and which url to hand over when (`story.render.url` once `rendered`, never the raw preview before): `story-episode` recipe, step 9. `story.render.status: "failed"` means it failed and was refunded: ask before rendering again. A repeat during a render answers the SAME `render_id` with `coalesced: true`: not a failure. COST: per rendered minute at the platform render rate, from the episode's own duration. `estimate_only: true` works only once the episode is renderable (before then it refuses and names the stage); earlier, give `pricing.render_tokens_per_minute` (series' full `list_series` entry) as a rate or a tilde figure, never as the price. THE GO THIS ONE NEEDS: after an `auto_render` fire it starts by itself: never call it then. Otherwise a render is its own charge and ask; approving the scene videos or saying the episode looks good is not a go to render. The user must name rendering or the final file, and a bare 'yes' counts only as the direct answer to your priced render ask. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_cost`, state it (or its job's total) in the same message as your ask, call at its price inside that go (SPENDING RULES: `get_recipe` `spending-rules`). `idempotency_key`: IDEMPOTENCY (this server's instructions).

watermark.description: The user's own logo, only if the user asked; changes no price. One of `watermark_id` or `house` (ids in `list_uploads`), or `image_url` (their upload). `size` 0.1-3 (1 = 300 px wide), `opacity` 0.05-1, `margin_x`/`margin_y` -120 to 120, `rotation` degrees.

name: render_story_video
title: Render a story episode (the final file)
